page_title: SUN 1-1 LEE | Sunderland v Leeds 28/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' The linesman signals that Omar Alderete (Sunderland) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' Corner kicks – 3:9.
86' Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
85' Daniel Farke has decided to substitute Dominic Calvert-Lewin and he is replaced by Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds).
85' The substitution is prepared. Romaine Mundle (Sunderland) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Simon Adingra.

85' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
84' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sunderland.
84' Simon Adingra (Sunderland) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
81' The game is interrupted as Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) is flagged offside.
80' Anton Stach (Leeds) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tony Harrington stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
76' Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
76' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Roefs is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Noah Okafor leaves the pitch and Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) comes on.
72' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) is caught offside!
70' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
70' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Leeds will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' Noah Okafor (Leeds) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Christopher Rigg will be replaced by Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland).
68' Substitution. Brian Brobbey leaves the pitch and is replaced by Wilson Isidor (Sunderland).
67' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.

66' Noah Okafor (Leeds) goes on a great individual run, arrives at the edge of the box and pulls the trigger. It was a promising effort which would have most likely gone past the goalkeeper if it hadn't been deflected by another offensive player.
63' Flag up against Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
61' Trai Hume (Sunderland) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
61' A short pass finds Brenden Aaronson (Leeds). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
61' Leeds quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
60' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Leeds win a corner.
59' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
59' Anton Stach (Leeds) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
57' Noah Okafor (Leeds) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tony Harrington saw the whole situation.
56' Leeds take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' Simon Adingra (Sunderland) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
54' Flag goes up against Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
53' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
52' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Leeds.
52' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
50' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Brenden Aaronson, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
45+2' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
45+1' Anton Stach (Leeds) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

45' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The ball goes out for a corner. Leeds can continue in their attacking effort.
44' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
41' The opposition back off Noah Okafor (Leeds) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky!
39' A pass lands at the feet of Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
37' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) commits a rough foul. Tony Harrington stops the game and makes a call.
35' Leeds failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Anton Stach (Leeds) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block. Leeds have a corner.
34' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
34' Corner kick. Leeds will have an opportunity.
34' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
31' Problems for Daniel Farke as Joe Rodon is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ao Tanaka (Leeds) replaces him.
30' Joe Rodon (Leeds) picks up an injury.
28' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Simon Adingra (Sunderland) was set free in the area by Granit Xhaka and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the right side of the net. 1:0.
27' Joe Rodon (Leeds) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
24' Joe Rodon (Leeds) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
22' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
19' Rough tackle by Noah Okafor (Leeds). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sunderland.
17' The ball is cleared after Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Sunderland are awarded a corner kick.
16' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
14' Leeds have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' Noah Okafor (Leeds) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Leeds earn a corner.
13' Tony Harrington blows his whistle after Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
11' Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
10' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
10' Anton Stach (Leeds) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Robin Roefs makes a save.
8' Leeds are seeing far more of the ball now.
5' Trai Hume (Sunderland) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
5' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
4' Noah Okafor (Leeds) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tony Harrington no option but to blow his whistle.
2' A dangerous looking corner kick from Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) is cleared to safety by the defence.

1' Simon Adingra (Sunderland) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Now Sunderland have a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Sunderland will have the kick-off.
Tony Harrington is the one to supervise the game today.
